en: Sepia-toned photograph of a European market square with historic multi-storey townhouses, a few early automobiles, pedestrians, and a large building with a tall clock tower and baroque-style dome on the right. The scene is spacious, showing the central marketplace area of a town. In the lower left corner, printed text reads "BORNA. Markt." indicating the market square of Borna.
